It repeats that page's visible text and adds nothing to it: Hamilton PCD 0 Skip to Content Home About Projects Grants Resources Donate Events Contact Us Open Menu Close Menu Home About Projects Grants Resources Donate Events Contact Us Open Menu Close Menu Home About Projects Grants Resources Donate Events Contact Us The PCD is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that works to enhance sustainable economic opportunity and community vitality in the Village and Town of Hamilton and the surrounding areas. Partnership for Community Development Help us transform Fayette St. Park! In 2025, the Village of Earlville received $627,847 through the Office of Parks, Recreation, and Historic Preservation for the redesign and construction of the pavilion, playground, and skate park on Fayette St. The PCD has been working with the Village and the Earlville community since 2020 to revitalize this important community space. With the planned construction of new senior housing in the adjacent former school building, Fayette St. Park will be transformed into a unique multi-generational space in southern Madison County. The PCD is excited to work with Earlville to make the community’s vision a reality. We are currently accepting donations to match the grant funding for this project. Your contributions will ensure that Fayette St. Park becomes an exceptional community space!
